summary.snapshotNotice: Frozen reference/engine snapshots; independent origin and conditions are declared, not authenticated. Current scene edits do not update these results.

validation.residualConvention: engine minus reference, dB; only identical sample ID/frequency/position pairs; no offset fitting
assumptions: Geometric blocking only: no edge diffraction or sound transmission. Shadows are approximate.
Finite reflectors use clipped image paths; no edge transition is modelled.
Venue walls and ceiling are visual context. Only assigned stage, Blocks and imported faces act as boundaries; the optional ground model is separate.
No reverberant tail, RT60 or STI prediction. No maximum-output or headroom prediction.
A 0 dB display value is a reporting floor, not proof of silence. Unavailable data is shown separately.
Not externally validated against manufacturer predictions or controlled measurements.
Imported origin/calibration/conditions are declarations, not authenticated.
Diagnostic residuals can be shown for incompatible datasets; they never change qualification.
Reordered rows may be paired by ID for inspection; strict comparison still rejects reordered datasets.

limitations: One unit, one session, one horizontal orbit and one radius; held-out angles share the measurement chain with training angles.
Unknown electrical drive, undocumented system preset and atmosphere; no absolute SPL, maximum output or independent-session validation.
Paper chamber quarter-wavelength limit about 425 Hz; 4 ms time window limits frequency resolution. No low-frequency extrapolation.
Band powers recomputed from original windowed IRs; published 1/24-octave plots are not used as numerical reference.
Magnitude-only data do not validate inter-source phase, array coherence, reflections, scattering or distance extrapolation.
